qa_pairs.question: What are the three components identified for 1986 models in the engine electrical layout?
qa_pairs.answer: 1 Control unit for DME (see Gr. 13), 2 Control unit for idle speed (see Gr. 13), 3 Plug for car electric system, fuel pump relay

qa_pairs.question: What wire colors are specified for the transmission versions plug (item 4)?
qa_pairs.answer: Green/yellow - blue/brown, not used for automatics (lean mixture), connected for manuals

qa_pairs.question: What are the wire colors for the air conditioner plug (item 5)?
What are the three relays shown in the relay box and what are they for?
qa_pairs.answer: Relay 1 for fuel pump, Relay 2 for DME, Relay 3 for oxygen sensor heating

qa_pairs.question: What four temperature-related components are identified in the engine bay?
qa_pairs.answer: 1 Temperature switch 45° C (113° F) for idle speed control, 2 Coolant temperature sensor for DME, 3 Temperature transmitter, 4 Temperature time switch

qa_pairs.question: What is the installation instruction for the twenty pin engine wire harness plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The screw-on cap engages in final position

qa_pairs.question: What sensors are identified by plugs B and D in the engine bay?
qa_pairs.answer: Plug (gray) for reference mark sensor (B) and plug for speed sensor (D)

qa_pairs.question: Where is the pressure sensor located according to the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The pressure sensor (see Gr. 13) is shown in the lower right area of the engine bay
